column3: NASB opens a parenthesis at “that is, all who” that runs through verse 2; “experienced” renders “known.”
NASB closes its parenthesis here; “might be taught war” renders “to know, to teach them war.”
“through Moses” renders “by the hand of Moses”; “fathers” renders “ancestors.”
“idols” renders a word that may also mean “carved stones”; “a secret message” renders “a word of secrecy,” and “Keep silence” renders “Hush!”
“his cool roof chamber” renders “the roof chamber of coolness which was his alone”; “seat” renders “throne.”
“the refuse came out” renders a rare word; the meaning is uncertain.
“vestibule” renders a rare word for a porch; the meaning is uncertain.
“He is only relieving himself” renders the euphemism “Surely he is covering his feet.”
“they waited until they became anxious” renders “they writhed until they were ashamed.”
“Pursue them” renders “Pursue after me”; “hands” renders the Hebrew singular “hand.”
